claim.value: Separate logs may share assumptions, so their separation does not guarantee independent evidence.
claim.scope: A possible shared-assumption mechanism, not a finding that these logs were produced from common assumptions.

provenance.rationale: P028 explicitly identifies shared assumptions as a possible source of dependence between separate logs.

signal_basis.value: Compare agreement or disagreement about the same equipment, booking and handoff while checking source access and copying; assess independence beyond the existence of separate logs, including possible shared assumptions.
signal_basis.scope: Assessment of evidential independence; agreement or separate recording does not itself demonstrate independent grounding.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the source checks, the comparison signal and the shared-assumption limitation.
The supported possibility claim requires no unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Distinct records can depend on the same assumptions, so record separation alone cannot guarantee evidential independence. This licenses the claim within its explicit possibility scope without establishing dependence in these particular logs.
uncertainty: Whether these logs actually share assumptions remains undetermined; that does not undermine the stated possibility.
